card.name: Handling steps: 'and' between actions
card.fires_on: The word 'and' joining two consecutive handling actions in preparation or cooking directions, such as remove from freezer and record. Also the space before a thaw time number.

modes.label: 'and' between actions
modes.description: The word 'and' links one handling step to the next in preparation or recipe instructions.
modes.example: Remove carton containing one single vial of CYTALUX from freezer<< and>> record the date, time and thawing

modes.label: Before a thaw time
modes.description: The space just before a number of minutes or hours for thawing.
modes.example: The contents of the vial will thaw in approximately<< >>30 minutes at room temperature.

card.plain: It marks the point in preparation directions where one handling step ends and the next action or a time span begins.
